# apicp Provider

Terraform provider for apicp — manage web vhosts, TLS certificates, DNS zones/records, databases, and mail domains/mailboxes via apicp's own control-plane API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    apicp = {
      source = "registry.terraform.io/abtme/apicp"
    }
  }
}

# url/token can also be set via the APICP_URL/APICP_TOKEN environment
# variables instead of hardcoding them here.
provider "apicp" {
  url   = "https://apicp.example.com"
  token = "apicp_..."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `token` (String, Sensitive) apicp bearer token. May also be set via the `APICP_TOKEN` environment variable.
- `url` (String) Base URL of the apicp control plane, e.g. `https://apicp.example.com`. May also be set via the `APICP_URL` environment variable.
